2. Proposed Facility
Lincoln Highway (U.S. 30) between Cicero Avenue (Illinois Route 50) and Western Avenue is proposed to be reconstructed from a four (4) lane undivided highway to three (3) twelve foot lanes in each direction separated by a sixteen (16) foot mountable median except for the section from Olympia Way to Brookwood Drive which will have a non-mountable median. From Western Avenue to Edgewood Avenue the proposed cross-section consists of two (2) twelve foot lanes in each direction separated by a sixteen foot mountable median. From Edgewood Avenue to Aberdeen Street the proposed cross-section consists of two (2) eleven foot lanes in each direction separated by a fourteen (14) foot median. In addition, the improvement will have curb and gutter from Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road. (Typical Cross Section is shown on Exhibit B, Location of Major Highway features are shown on Exhibit C.)
B. Description and Relationship of Section 4(f) Land to the Highway Improvement 
1. Size and Location:
The Woodrow Wilson Woods is approximately 31 acres located between Chicago Road on the east, Edgewood Avenue on the west and on the north side of Lincoln Highway in the City of Chicago Heights, Cook County, Illinois.
The Lincoln Highway improvement will necessitate a temporary construction easement for the removal of bridge wing walls over Thorn Creek. The new bridge will be completely within the existing right-of-way. In order to provide the necessary hydraulic requirements on Lincoln Highway over the Thorn Creek Bridge, it is necessary to raise the profile grade on Lincoln Highway. This change in grade affects the Forest Preserve District's entrance immediately west of the Thorn Creek Bridge to the extent that it is necessary to rebuild this driveway so that a more desirable grade can be obtained. The total amount of temporary easement from Woodrow Wilson Woods is 0.17 acres.
